fix_problems: run fix_problems on a BMGraphBuilder to apply all graph fixers and return errors
arithmetic_graph_fixer: build an arithmetic graph fixer that transforms addition, bool, and log operations in a BMGraphBuilder
conjugacy_graph_fixer: create a conjugacy graph fixer to optimize beta bernoulli and normal normal conjugate priors
node_fixer_first_match: compose multiple node fixers and apply the first matching one to a graph node
default_skip_optimizations: review the default skip optimizations set to see which conjugate fixers are disabled by default
